name: max()
what_it_does: Returns the largest item in an iterable, or the largest of several arguments passed directly.
syntax: max(iterable) or max(a, b, c, ...) or max(iterable, key=func)
parameters: Either one iterable of comparable values, or two or more individual values. Optional key= - a function applied to each item before comparing.
common_mistakes: max() on an empty list raises ValueError. Like min(), mixing incompatible types raises TypeError.
when_to_use: Finding the highest value in a dataset, or (with key=) finding the item that scores highest by some custom measure, e.g. max(words, key=len) for the longest word.
